page_summary: This page discusses essential cybersecurity measures for ports, emphasizing the importance of basic cyber hygiene and additional strategies from the MITRE ATT&CK® database. It highlights the vulnerabilities of OT-enabled systems, particularly those operated by third-party vendors, and recommends measures such as multi-factor authentication and controlled access to mitigate risks. The text underscores the need for robust cybersecurity obligations for suppliers to protect against external compromises.

regions.description: Text discussing cybersecurity measures, vulnerabilities of OT-enabled systems, and recommendations for improving cybersecurity in ports.
